description.value: Kings Motor Inn is an affordable highway motel on the Trans-Canada in Kamloops offering a range of room types including kitchenette options with mountain views. Guests have access to an indoor pool, a BBQ area, and 24-hour front desk service. It is a dog-friendly property positioned as a convenient stopover for travelers passing through Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and describes a functioning motel with clearly listed amenities including free Wi-Fi, indoor pool, BBQ area, dog-friendly policy, and fridge/microwave in every room; none of the cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned, so those remain null. The website displays a local Kamloops phone number (+1-250-372-2800) that differs from the OSM-recorded toll-free number (+1-844-551-7510), flagged as a discrepancy. The discovered URL has medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags, so website contact_confirmed is null.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-844-551-7510 (toll-free) but the website prominently displays +1-250-372-2800 (local Kamloops number); website value used as primary.
Website URL was discovered with medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags; could not cross-check URL against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops with an active website; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists.

price.label: Budget
price.signal: Explicitly marketed as 'Affordable Motel' with 'reasonable prices'; standard motel amenities
